title: I can't hide the pagination when there is only one result page.

comments.body:
One way to solve this would be to add a CSS class on the wrapper denoting how many pages in the pagination we have.

Something like `ais-pagination__pagecount-1`, `ais-pagination__pagecount-2`, etc.

I've had a go at a PR https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1049, but I'm wondering if we should use the number of max pages, or the number of displayed pages.

(Please answer in the PR)
This was solved using a simple custom widget https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/1049#issuecomment-222927757
